init_wandb_singleton: initialize a wandb singleton logger with config, run_id, run_name, log_dir, project, and entity
log_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the singleton logger with optional step and commit
log_table_wandb: log a wandb table with column names and row data using the singleton logger
log_dataframe_wandb: log a pandas dataframe as a wandb table using the singleton logger
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics to wandb using the convenience log_stats function on the master process
